verified_facts.text: The Ritz opened in 1906.
verified_facts.excerpt: When The Ritz opened its doors in 1906

verified_facts.text: The Ritz was conceived by the hotelier Cesar Ritz.
verified_facts.excerpt: Conceived by the famous hotelier César Ritz

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits between Piccadilly and Green Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated between the bustling Piccadilly and the calm oasis of the stunning Royal Green Park

verified_facts.text: Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace, the West End theatres and Bond Street are close to the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace, West End Theatres, Bond Street, and so much more on our doorstep.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Restaurant's Executive Chef is John Williams MBE.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz Restaurant’s Executive Chef, John Williams MBE, crafts lunch and dinner menus showcasing seasonal local ingredients through his mastery of contemporary British cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Restaurant sits beneath a soaring glass roof.
verified_facts.excerpt: set within an elegant venue beneath a soaring glass roof

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Restaurant was named Restaurant of the Year at the National Restaurant Awards 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz Restaurant has been awarded the prestigious title of Restaurant of the Year by The National Restaurant Awards 2025.

verified_facts.text: Every Friday and Saturday, Live at The Ritz pairs dinner with live music and dancing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every Friday and Saturday, “Live at The Ritz” transforms dinner into an evening of fine dining, live music, and dancing.

verified_facts.text: The Arts de la Table menu features gueridon tableside service, with dishes completed and plated at the table.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Arts de la Table four-course menu features guéridon tableside service, a refined technique where dishes are completed and plated at your table.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea cakes are served tableside from the gueridon trolley and change seasonally.
verified_facts.excerpt: Served tableside from the guéridon trolley, they change seasonally

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea is accompanied by an elegant musical ensemble in the 18th-century William Kent House.
verified_facts.excerpt: An elegant musical ensemble accompanies your service, completing the Afternoon Tea experience within the stunning 18th-century William Kent House.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz London's Tea Master, Giandomenico Scanu, travels to tea plantations worldwide to source its loose-leaf teas.
verified_facts.excerpt: He travels to tea plantations worldwide to source our loose-leaf teas

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea includes freshly baked scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry preserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: freshly baked scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry preserve

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea service is continuous, with courses replenished throughout the visit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Service is continuous, with courses replenished throughout your visit.

verified_facts.text: The Rivoli Bar has a red and green marble chequerboard floor inspired by William Kent.
verified_facts.excerpt: centred around a striking red and green marble chequerboard floor inspired by William Kent

verified_facts.text: The Rivoli Bar has restored historic vaulted ceilings with hand-painted gold motifs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Restored historic vaulted ceilings, enhanced with hand-painted gold motifs

verified_facts.text: The Rivoli Bar's bartenders will tailor a cocktail to a guest's personal taste.
verified_facts.excerpt: The experienced bartenders are delighted to tailor drinks to personal tastes

verified_facts.text: The Secret Garden is an outdoor dining and drinking space within The Ritz London.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Secret Garden, an enchanting outdoor dining and drinking destination in Mayfair, is a hidden oasis set within The Ritz London.

verified_facts.text: The Secret Garden was created by Marcus Barnett Studios.
verified_facts.excerpt: Created by Marcus Barnett Studios

verified_facts.text: The Secret Garden's planting features irises, hellebores, hydrangeas, crab-apple trees and white wisteria.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring irises, hellebores, hydrangeas, crab-apple trees and white wisteria

verified_facts.text: The Secret Garden offers bespoke cashmere throws by Johnston's of Elgin as the evening cools.
verified_facts.excerpt: bespoke cashmere throws by Johnston’s of Elgin invite guests to linger

verified_facts.text: The Secret Garden opens weather permitting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opening times _(weather permitting)_

verified_facts.text: The Ritz 120 cocktail was created to celebrate the hotel's 120th anniversary.
verified_facts.excerpt: the newly launched Ritz 120, created to celebrate the hotel’s 120th anniversary

verified_facts.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms have marble bathrooms with a deep soaking bathtub, rainfall shower, double vanity and heated marble floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious marble bathroom with deep soaking bathtub, rainfall shower, double vanity, and heated marble floors

verified_facts.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms have Bang & Olufsen Beosound speakers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bang & Olufsen Beosound speakers and an integrated 55” smart TV with casting functionality

verified_facts.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms have silk wall coverings and hand-finished mouldings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hand-finished mouldings, richly woven carpets, silk wall coverings and period-inspired furnishings

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite spans two floors with views of Green Park and The Secret Garden through floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exceptional one-bedroom suite, spanning 204 square metres (2,195 sq ft) over two floors, offers views of Green Park and The Secret Garden through floor-to-ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: Junior Suites have fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: showcasing cosy fireplaces and spacious, comfortable sofas

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an 8th-generation Rolls-Royce Phantom EWB, hand-built in England and custom-made to match the hotel's design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our iconic 8th-generation Ritz Rolls-Royce Phantom EWB was hand-built in England and custom-made to match our hotel’s design.

verified_facts.text: The Rolls-Royce is available for hire as an exclusive service for resident guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The car is also available for hire as an exclusive service for resident guests

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a personal butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our renowned personal butler service elevates luxury

verified_facts.text: The Concierge team has a collective experience of over 150 years.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a collective experience of over 150 years, our team is a treasure trove of information

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Cigar Shop where guests can sample cigars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ritz London Cigar Shop offers the perfect setting to sample a cigar, chosen from our prestigious selection, indoors in our comfortable lounge.

verified_facts.text: The kidz@theritz package provides game consoles for older children, age-appropriate books and DVDs, and a complimentary Ritz teddy for younger children.
verified_facts.excerpt: We provide game consoles in your rooms for older children, a selection of age-appropriate books and DVDs, and a complimentary Ritz teddy for younger children to cuddle.

verified_facts.text: There is a Children's Afternoon Tea with a decaffeinated tea chosen by the Tea Master.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Tea Master has chosen the perfect specially blended decaffeinated tea

verified_facts.text: Gentlemen must wear a jacket and tie for Afternoon Tea and for lunch and dinner in The Ritz Restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gentlemen are required to wear a jacket and tie (jeans and sportswear are not permitted for either ladies or gentlemen) for Afternoon Tea and for lunch and dinner in The Ritz Restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Smart casual attire is acceptable at breakfast, The Rivoli Bar, The Secret Garden and The Cigar Shop.
verified_facts.excerpt: In all other areas of the hotel (The Ritz breakfast service, The Rivoli Bar, The Secret Garden, and The Cigar Shop), smart casual attire is acceptable.

verified_facts.text: Sportswear is not permitted in any of the hotel's restaurants or bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that sportswear is not permitted in any of the hotel’s restaurants or bars.

verified_facts.text: An additional entertainment charge applies to a la carte or Epicurean menus when live entertainment runs on Friday and Saturday evenings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live entertainment is provided on Friday and Saturday evenings. If you choose the à la carte or Epicurean menus, there is an additional entertainment charge of £58 per person.
